category_edits.rationale: Increase pointwise logistic supervision from 0.2 to 0.4 across all four category models to test whether stronger absolute-score supervision improves ranking stability. Preserve the pairwise term, nonpadding reduction, architecture, sampling and training settings; predictor and checkpoint formats remain compatible.

change_summary: Increase only the pointwise logistic loss coefficient from 0.2 to 0.4.
